description: Assign the bracket's matches to courts and start times (organizer step 4, after generate_bracket; needs manage_code). Scheduling is dependency-aware: rounds run in waves across the courts and a round never starts before the previous round has ended, so no match is ever scheduled before the matches feeding it have finished. PREVIEW FIRST: call without confirm_preview_id — returns a preview_id plus per-match court/time assignments and a validation block whose court_time_conflicts and dependency_violations are computed from the produced schedule, and nothing is written. Show the preview to the user, then commit with {tournament_id, code, confirm_preview_id}.

confirm_preview_id.description: preview_id from the preview call — pass only to commit that exact preview

courts.description: Number of courts to schedule across

start_time.description: First match start time, HH:MM, default 09:00

name: schedule_matches
